caveat: Simulation only: flat straight road, ideal pinhole lens, box-shaped vehicles, background subtraction detector, one parameter varied at a time around a 6 m / 60 deg / 1280x720 / 30 fps baseline with the zone 20-50 m from the pole. Treat as a starting point for the field pilot, not as validated limits.
